prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, reorder] Story context scroll prior to path decision: Reorders onboarding so the story introduction screen appears before choose_path, giving context before users pick a path. (why: The choose_path screen takes a mean time of 514s and drops 21.6% of users due to lacking context on what paths offer.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing account pet sync warning hint: Displays a clear reminder hint on sign_in encouraging users to log in with their original sign-in method to avoid pet resets. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest category) regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with a secondary method.)
2: [adoption, copy] Clear adoption certificate commitment callout: Updates headline and body text on adoption_certificate to clearly explain that naming their pet finalizes companion creation. (why: Adoption step suffers from low conversion (60.9%) and long completion times (mean 1017s).)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen timer count update: Enables time estimation readout and a visual timer component on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The home waiting step has high mean latency (2336s), leaving users unsure if generation is progressing.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Stage spotlight layout for path options: Switches choose_path layout to spotlight layout to highlight key path features clearly. (why: choose_path drops 21.6% of users and takes 514s mean time; focusing visual attention speeds up decision making.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo upload quality requirement checklist: Adds a photo criteria checklist component on upload_photos detailing lighting and positioning for optimal pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted visual outcomes.)
